faq_heading: Homes near Woodland Park Elementary: your questions answered

faq.q: Are the homes on this page in the Woodland Park Elementary catchment?
faq.a: Not necessarily. The search finds homes whose listing names the school, and the sold prices are measured by distance. Surrey School District sets the catchment and shows it on a map only on its website, so confirm the exact address with the district before you offer.

faq.q: How does the Woodland Park Elementary home search find homes?
faq.a: It lists active homes whose listing text names Woodland Park Elementary, so a nearby home that leaves the name out will not show.

faq.q: How much do homes near Woodland Park Elementary sell for?
faq.a: Within 1 km of the school, 110 homes sold between November 1, 2025 and October 31, 2026. Medians were houses $1,235,000, townhomes $730,000, condos $590,000. A median is the middle price and is shown where at least 5 homes sold.

faq.q: How fast do homes sell near Woodland Park Elementary?
faq.a: Within 1 km of Woodland Park Elementary the median was 36 days on the market, closing at 96.9% of the list price, with 11% of sales above the list price for the 110 homes within 1 km.

faq.q: Which schools are closest to Woodland Park Elementary?
faq.a: In a straight line, the closest schools in the provincial list are St Matthew's Elementary (0.7 km south-east), Holy Cross Regional High School (0.8 km south-east) and Surrey Christian School (0.9 km east).

Woodland Park Elementary is an elementary school in Surrey (Surrey School District), at 9025 158 St. It teaches grades K to 7.
Use the search below to see homes for sale that name Woodland Park Elementary in the listing, then check the sold prices within 1 km of the school.
How the Woodland Park Elementary search works

MLS® listings are not tagged by school. This search finds houses, townhomes and condos whose description names Woodland Park Elementary, so a home close to the school whose listing leaves the name out will not appear, and a listing that names the school can sit farther than 1 km away. Use the sold prices below for the distance-based picture, and ask Jared to watch for homes near the school that the search misses.
What homes within 1 km of Woodland Park Elementary sold for
Between November 1, 2025 and October 31, 2026, 110 homes sold within 1 km of Woodland Park Elementary: 37 houses, 37 townhomes and 36 condos. The largest group was houses, at a median of $1,235,000.

blocks.text: Schools within 3 km of Woodland Park Elementary

23 schools in the provincial school list sit within 3 km of Woodland Park Elementary in a straight line (16 elementary, 5 secondary, 2 other; 5 independent). The closest is St Matthew's Elementary, 0.7 km away, and the farthest on this list is Janice Churchill Elementary, 2.9 km away. By type, the nearest secondary school is Holy Cross Regional High School (0.8 km); the nearest school listing a French Immersion program is North Surrey Secondary (1.1 km). Other elementary schools close by: St Matthew's Elementary (0.7 km south-east), Serpentine Heights Elementary (1.0 km north-east), Berkshire Park Elementary (1.1 km north-west), Frost Road Elementary (1.2 km south-east), William F. Davidson Elementary (1.9 km north). The nearest school teaching the same grades (K-7) is St Matthew's Elementary, 0.7 km south-east of Woodland Park Elementary.
